# First, get team-level foul effects
team_foul_effects <- foul_binomial_model_vs_mo_2 %>%
  spread_draws(
    r_defensive_team[defensive_team,],
    r_defensive_team_modefender_foul_count[defensive_team,],
    simo_modefender_foul_count1[category]
  ) %>%
  # Calculate team-level effects for each foul count
  mutate(
    effect_0 = r_defensive_team,
    effect_1 = r_defensive_team + r_defensive_team_modefender_foul_count * simo_modefender_foul_count1[1],
    effect_2 = r_defensive_team + r_defensive_team_modefender_foul_count * (simo_modefender_foul_count1[1] + simo_modefender_foul_count1[2]),
    effect_3 = r_defensive_team + r_defensive_team_modefender_foul_count * (simo_modefender_foul_count1[1] + simo_modefender_foul_count1[2] + simo_modefender_foul_count1[3]),
    effect_4 = r_defensive_team + r_defensive_team_modefender_foul_count * (simo_modefender_foul_count1[1] + simo_modefender_foul_count1[2] + simo_modefender_foul_count1[3] + simo_modefender_foul_count1[4]),
    effect_5 = r_defensive_team + r_defensive_team_modefender_foul_count * (simo_modefender_foul_count1[1] + simo_modefender_foul_count1[2] + simo_modefender_foul_count1[3] + simo_modefender_foul_count1[4] + simo_modefender_foul_count1[5])
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("effect_"),
    names_to = "foul_count",
    values_to = "team_effect"
  ) %>%
  mutate(foul_count = as.numeric(str_extract(foul_count, "\\d+"))) %>%
  group_by(defensive_team, foul_count) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_team_effect = mean(team_effect),
    lower_team_95 = quantile(team_effect, 0.025),
    upper_team_95 = quantile(team_effect, 0.975)
  )
